audit.whatIsWrong: The two sides of this matchup are irreconcilable and I did not guess. This page reads Skill / Volibear x5 / Skill; the already-audited mirror was set to Skill / Gragas / Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Volibear. The two packet charts are direct inverses.
audit.why: Adopting the mirror would mean writing that Gragas wins levels 2 through first item, against a 52.97% Volibear win rate over 572 games and against every mechanical fact on this page (300-range melee brawl, 5s Frenzied Maul heal). Adopting this page's chart would contradict a mirror that is already written. Inventing a resolution is worse than flagging it, so the chart and every why, spike and phase line that depends on it are left untouched.
audit.corrected: Deferred to the user — see questionsForUser. Only chart-neutral mechanical corrections are proposed below.

audit.why: Spike timings themselves are sound and chart-independent: Volibear's are level 3 (full kit), level 6 Stormbringer at 160s, and Sundered Sky; Gragas's are Body Slam online, level 6 Explosive Cask at 100s, and his AP-tank build.
audit.corrected: Left as written; the numbers now appear in the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Body Slam is described only as 'his escape' in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Gragas charges to a location and collides with the first enemy unit he comes across, dealing damage to all nearby enemy units and stunning them.' It is a 600-range hard-CC engage on 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s — calling it an escape hides the half that kills you.
audit.corrected: A 600-range stun on 14s at rank 1; it is his engage as much as his escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Fight in his Q puddle' has generic filler text under it and never explains the actual mechanic.
audit.why: Riot's text: the cask 'can be activated to explode or will explode on its own after 4 seconds. The potency of the explosion increases over time.' Standing on it is punished harder the longer you stand.
audit.corrected: The cask grows stronger the longer it sits and detonates on its own after 4 seconds.

audit.why: Happy Hour heals him every time he uses a skill, so the existing Executioner's Calling first-back recommendation is right for the reason the page does not state.
audit.corrected: Kept; anti-heal is correct here because his passive heals off every cast, not off attacks.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Use Explosive Cask' in wants.foe[2]. The ability name is correct; the matcher caught the leading verb. The mirror reached the same conclusion.

edits.before: - Gragas Body Slam: matchup-defining — His escape. All-in when it’s down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Body Slam: matchup-defining — 14s at rank 1, 600 range, and it stuns; it is his engage as much as his escape.

edits.before: His escape. All-in when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 600-range stun on 14s, not just an escape. Commit once he has spent it.

edits.before: Track Gragas's Body Slam: His escape. All-in when it’s down. When it is down — Q-stun + all-in him.
edits.after: Body Slam is a 600-range stun on 14s. Barrel Roll reaches 850 and the cask self-detonates after 4s.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The cask grows stronger the longer it sits and blows on its own after 4 seconds.
